   **Bugs and stability.**
      17 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Oct 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tech44_, Oct 13, 2026, 1/5: "Well, Notion is a great service to organize just about any type of information, but the iOS app is terrible. Incredibly buggy, that seems to get worse with every update. I’m still using it because I have too much invested in the platform, so I hope they get around to fixing everything."
            2. _User1opj_, Oct 9, 2026, 1/5: "If I had not used it in writing notes in Mac already, I would never used it in my iPad cause the app here is disappointing for the following reasons This app is difficult to use as a note taken in IOS : - Always lagging - when I try to type using iPad keyboard I can’t see what I am writing cause the page will scroll down every single time - not apple pencil friendly, text difficult to recognize (when I try to select words[writing and editing using it is something I had long since learned that they will never fix it{) - AI support is not optimum in iPad, whenever I will use it the app will lag and I need to close it and reopen to continue my notes taken - can not search in the page alone - I can not change the color of any text , it will immediately lag , and do not apply the color changes - difficult to move text Keep in mind I am using a new empty page !!!"
            3. _emilie_hys_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "It worked really well but now the whole app is buggy, I could easily change the writing colors by tapping on the dots at the edge of the line/paragraph but it doesn't work anymore. moreover, as soon as I try to write a letter, my text goes up, which means that I cannot see what I am writing..; It's a shame it was great before that"
